display.purpose: The site title in the masthead.

display-rail.purpose: The site title in the legend rail at 64rem and more.

headline.purpose: The heading of an area section.

title.purpose: The name link of a repo entry. In the Start here path it is 1.18rem: a link to a page, or plain ink text for a step with links to other sites.

numeral.purpose: The step numbers of the Start here path, muted, in the margin number column.

body.purpose: All running text, in the system sans.

body-small.purpose: Entry links, the snapshot line, and the Go deeper line.

label.purpose: Area keys in the legend rail and the hover name of a strip cell.

label-rail.purpose: The repo names in the upright estate strip.

label-nav.purpose: The jump links to the areas, and the back links of a text page.

mono.purpose: Commit ids and code only: inline code and code blocks on a text page.

display-text.purpose: The h1 of a text page.

headline-text.purpose: The h2 of a text page, under a 2px ink rule.

title-text.purpose: The h3 of a text page.

title-small.purpose: The h4 of a text page, with text-wrap: balance.

label-table.purpose: The table heads of a text page, on the surface.

shadows.name: ink-edge
shadows.purpose: The 1px ink outline on every area fill (strip cells, mark cells, chips). An outline, not an elevation.

shadows.name: diagram-scroll-shadows
shadows.value: linear-gradient(to right, <surface> 30%, <surface>00) left / 2rem 100% no-repeat local, linear-gradient(to left, <surface> 30%, <surface>00) right / 2rem 100% no-repeat local, radial-gradient(farthest-side at 0 50%, <ink>40, <ink>00) left / .75rem 100% no-repeat scroll, radial-gradient(farthest-side at 100% 50%, <ink>40, <ink>00) right / .75rem 100% no-repeat scroll
shadows.purpose: The one exception to the Flat Map Rule: the cue that a wide diagram scrolls. The surface and the ink come from site-colors.mjs, light and dark. A .75rem shade of 25% ink shows only on a side with more of the diagram.

motion.name: ease-cell
motion.purpose: The move of a strip cell color block on hover or focus.

motion.name: duration-cell
motion.purpose: The move of a strip cell color block: 4px up, or 3px right in the legend rail.

motion.name: duration-label
motion.purpose: The fade of the repo name under the strip.

breakpoints.name: phone-title
breakpoints.purpose: The display title takes a width of 78%.

breakpoints.name: strip-links
breakpoints.purpose: A container query on the masthead, computed by build-landing.mjs from the repo counts (CELL_GAP 2px, AREA_GAP 6px): the estate strip (links) replaces the estate mark where each cell can be 24px wide. 422px of strip today (a 462px page at a 16px default font size). It changes with the repo counts.

breakpoints.name: legend-rail
breakpoints.purpose: The sticky 17.5rem legend rail (`--rail`) with the upright estate strip. The rail always shows the links and never the estate mark. The parcel field lies under the rail, with the rail-edge hairline at its edge. `WIDE` in site-html.mjs; `NARROW` (`not all and (min-width: 64rem)`) is its exact opposite and puts the parcel field under the masthead. On a text page the legend rail is sticky, holds the estate mark (up to 13.5rem x .75rem) over the back links, and main is at most 64rem with the reading column at the left.

breakpoints.name: text-page-band
breakpoints.purpose: `NARROW` on a text page: the masthead is a band at the top with a hairline below, the estate mark is 8.5rem x .55rem, and the reading column (44rem) is in the center.

components.name: Estate Strip
components.description: One cell per repo, grouped by area, in the area colors; each cell links to its repo entry and shows its name on hover or focus. Shown from the masthead width where each cell can be 24px wide.

components.css: :host { --ground: #f3f5f0; --surface: #e8ece5; --ink: #1b2420; --muted: #56625a; --link: #2c5d84; --line: #c5cec3; --edge: color-mix(in srgb, #1b2420 25%, transparent); --display: "Archivo", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --c-ink: #1b2420; --c-evergreen: #35614e; --c-cropland: #92600d; --c-shrub: #bba25b; --c-wetland: #6f9db3; --c-deciduous: #6c8951; --c-mixed-forest: #b1bd97; --c-bare-ground: #7c796e; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ground: #131915; --surface: #1b231e; --ink: #e2e8e0; --muted: #9aa79e; --link: #8fb9d9; --line: #2e3a33; --edge: color-mix(in srgb, #e2e8e0 25%, transparent); --c-ink: #e2e8e0; --c-evergreen: #33634d; --c-cropland: #916618; --c-shrub: #b49e56; --c-wetland: #7fb0c6; --c-deciduous: #49854f; --c-mixed-forest: #b1b38e; --c-bare-ground: #858377; } } .ds-tmast { padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--ground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-tmark { display: flex; gap: 3px; width: 8.5rem; height: .55rem; margin-bottom: .75rem; } .ds-tgroup { display: flex; flex: var(--n) 1 0; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-tmark i { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; background: var(--area); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--edge); } .ds-tnav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem 1.5rem; font: 500 .98rem/1.3 var(--display); font-stretch: 87.5%; } .ds-tnav a { display: inline-block; padding-block: .15rem; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tnav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--line); } .ds-tnav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--link); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Diagram Plate
components.description: A Mermaid diagram on a surface plate: nodes on the ground with a muted border and ink labels in Archivo; a repo node in a 30% tint of its area color with a 1.5px border in the area color.
components.css: :host { --ground: #f3f5f0; --surface: #e8ece5; --ink: #1b2420; --muted: #56625a; --link: #2c5d84; --line: #c5cec3; --edge: color-mix(in srgb, #1b2420 25%, transparent); --display: "Archivo", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --c-ink: #1b2420; --c-evergreen: #35614e; --c-cropland: #92600d; --c-shrub: #bba25b; --c-wetland: #6f9db3; --c-deciduous: #6c8951; --c-mixed-forest: #b1bd97; --c-bare-ground: #7c796e; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ground: #131915; --surface: #1b231e; --ink: #e2e8e0; --muted: #9aa79e; --link: #8fb9d9; --line: #2e3a33; --edge: color-mix(in srgb, #e2e8e0 25%, transparent); --c-ink: #e2e8e0; --c-evergreen: #33634d; --c-cropland: #916618; --c-shrub: #b49e56; --c-wetland: #7fb0c6; --c-deciduous: #49854f; --c-mixed-forest: #b1b38e; --c-bare-ground: #858377; } } .ds-plate { padding: 1.5rem 1rem; text-align: center; background: var(--surface); } .ds-node rect { fill: var(--ground); stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1px; } .ds-node text { fill: var(--ink); font: 400 13px var(--display); text-anchor: middle; } .ds-edge { stroke: var(--muted); stroke-width: 1.5px; fill: none; } .ds-area-node rect { fill: color-mix(in srgb, var(--area) 30%, var(--ground)); stroke: var(--area); stroke-width: 1.5px; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a land-cover classification map of the code estate. Each area of repos is a land-cover class. Each class has one flat, muted area color. The snapshot commit is the scene date. The reader sees the whole estate in one estate strip, learns the area key, follows the numbered Start here path, and then finds a repo entry with its proof links.

The site look is calm and dense. The page is a mineral ground with evergreen-black ink. Hairline rules divide the content. The parcel field, the faint ink boundaries of made-up field parcels, lies behind the legend rail. It is decoration, not data. Apart from the link blue, the area colors are the only saturated colors on the page, and they fill shapes only. The pages follow the color scheme of the reader, so each color is a pair: one value for light, one value for dark (the `-dark` tokens). The site look refuses the GitHub-clone docs look (the former look) and the stock eco template: no leaf art, no gradients, no drop shadows, no Greenstand logo.

Scope of this record: the landing page, the text pages, and the shared base are in the site look. The shared base is the colors in `.github/scripts/site-colors.mjs`, `siteStyle`, `siteHead`, and the estate mark (`estateMark`, `areaGroup`, `areaStyle`) in `.github/scripts/site-html.mjs`, and the parcel field (`.github/scripts/build-parcel-field.mjs` writes `art/parcel-field.svg`). `build-landing.mjs` writes the landing page. `render-md.mjs` writes the text pages: the ecosystem maps, the shared-resource page, the estate glossary, the volunteer guide, and the onboarding guide, the README, and the glossary of each repo. The landing page and the text pages show the parcel field. The capture journey page (`capture-journey-page.mjs`) and the moved pages (`build-moved.mjs`) still show the former look (`BASE_STYLE`). Later work moves them, and a later pass brings this file up to date. `BASE_STYLE` is not a rule source.
keyCharacteristics: A mineral ground, an ink text color, and water blue for links only, from one data module of [light, dark] pairs.
Eight area colors (seven land-cover classes and ink for Organization) that fill cells, chips, and rules, never text.
An ink edge on each area fill, so that pale fills stay visible on the ground.
Archivo (a variable face with a width axis) for headings, labels, and numerals; the system sans for body text.
Square corners, hairline rules, and no elevation.
The parcel field: the faint, still ink boundaries of made-up field parcels under the legend rail on a wide screen and under the masthead on a phone. The content column stays plain.

The estate strip as the signature: a picture on a phone, a row of links on a wider page, an upright legend in the legend rail on a wide screen. A text page shows it small, as the estate mark over the back links.
Diagrams on a plate in the surface color, with each repo node in a tint of its area color.

rules.name: The One Color, One Job Rule
rules.body: An area color marks its area and nothing else. It fills cells, chips, rules, and tints. It never colors text. Water blue is for links only. The state colors are for states only.

rules.name: The Two Backgrounds Rule
rules.body: Each text color has a contrast of 4.5:1 or more on each background (the ground and the surface), in light and in dark mode. `.github/scripts/check-site-colors.mjs` enforces it in CI. Add a new text color to `TEXTS` in `site-colors.mjs`, so that CI checks it.

rules.name: The State Apart Rule
rules.body: Each area color is 10 or more (CIE76) from each state color, in both schemes. CI enforces it. Thus an area color does not look like a state.

rules.name: The Color-Blind Key Rule
rules.body: Each two area colors are 10 or more apart (CIEDE2000), in both schemes, for normal vision and for simulated protanopia and deuteranopia (Machado 2009, severity 1). CI enforces it. A new area color must pass this check before a page uses it.

rules.name: The Ink Edge Rule
rules.body: Every area fill carries the ink edge (a 1px inset outline in 25% ink). Pale fills, for example Mixed Forest Sage, stay visible on the ground.

rules.name: The Faint Field Rule
rules.body: The parcel field at full mask has a contrast of 1.25:1 or less with the ground, so it stays in the background. Each text color has a contrast of 4.5:1 or more on the field, because the title and the estate strip lie on it. The ink share is above 0 and at most 100. `check-site-colors.mjs` enforces these rules in CI, in light and in dark mode. Today the field is 1.2489:1 (light) and 1.2480:1 (dark) to the ground. The weakest text on the field is best-guess at 4.64:1 and muted at 4.66:1, both in light mode. Change the strength of the field only in `PARCEL_FIELD_INK_SHARE`.

rules.name: The Node Tint Rule
rules.body: The node of a repo in a diagram has a fill of its area color at `DIAGRAM_NODE_TINT` (30%) mixed with the ground. The ink labels have a contrast of 4.5:1 or more on the node tint of each area color, in light and in dark mode. The tint is a percent above 0 and at most 100. `check-site-colors.mjs` enforces these rules in CI. Today the weakest label is ink on the ink tint (Organization): 7.76:1 in light mode and 5.93:1 in dark mode. Change the tint only in `DIAGRAM_NODE_TINT`.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo sets headings, labels, and numerals. The system sans sets the body text. Monospace sets code and commit ids only.

rules.name: The Narrow Label Rule
rules.body: Archivo labels use a width of 87.5%. Numerals use a width of 75%. The full width is for headings. Headings use `text-wrap: balance`.

rules.name: The No Lone Word Rule
rules.body: `siteStyle` sets `text-wrap: pretty` on paragraphs, list items, `dd`, and quotes, on every page in the site look. Thus the browser avoids one word alone on the last line of a paragraph.

rules.name: The 24 px Target Rule
rules.body: A strip cell is a link only where it can be 24px wide. Below that width, the strip is the estate mark: a picture with no links and no words, hidden from screen readers. Do not hard-code the width; compute it from the repo counts and test it on the masthead container, not on the page. In the legend rail each row is at least `max(1.5rem, 24px)` high, so the rail always has links.

rules.name: The Flat Map Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at all times. Use tone (the surface) and hairlines for structure. Use no drop shadow and no gradient. The one exception is the scroll shadows of a wide diagram: they are the cue that a diagram scrolls, and they show nowhere else. The parcel field is a flat ink layer behind the page, not a surface above it.

dos: Do take every color from `BACKGROUNDS`, `TEXTS`, `STATES`, `LINES`, and `AREA_COLORS` in `site-colors.mjs`, as a [light, dark] pair, through the CSS custom properties of `siteStyle`.

Do define every custom property that a page uses. `build-landing.mjs` and `render-md.mjs` fail when a page uses a custom property that nothing defines (`undefinedProperties` in `site-html.mjs`; the check skips scripts).
Do let a page build fail when a file that the page loads is missing. `render-md.mjs` shows every missing file at once: the font, the parcel field, and (for a page with a diagram) Mermaid.
Do write the estate mark with `estateMark`, `areaGroup`, and `areaStyle` from `site-html.mjs`, and give it its size in the page style.
Do take the diagram colors from `site-colors.mjs` through the Mermaid `themeVariables`, and change the tint of a repo node only in `DIAGRAM_NODE_TINT`.
Do give an element its area color with `--area: var(--c-<color>)`, from the `"color"` of its area in `estate.json`.
Do put the ink edge (1px inset, 25% ink) on every area fill.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or more on the ground, on the surface, and on the parcel field in both schemes, and let `check-site-colors.mjs` prove it. Text may sit on the parcel field.
Do change the strength of the parcel field only in `PARCEL_FIELD_INK_SHARE`, and keep the field at 1.25:1 or less with the ground.
Do hide the parcel field and the rail-edge hairline in forced colors, with `prefers-contrast: more`, and in print.
Do set headings, labels, and numerals in Archivo, and body text in the system sans.
Do keep a strip cell at 24px or more wherever it is a link.
Do turn off motion under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: Don't color text with an area color.
Don't show a state by its state color alone.
Don't use water blue for anything but links and the focus ring.
Don't use a drop shadow, a gradient, a rounded corner, or leaf art. The one exception is the scroll shadows of a wide diagram (see the Flat Map Rule).
Don't use the default look of Mermaid; it draws node shadows. Use the "classic" look.
Don't add a Greenstand logo or Greenstand brand colors. The site has no binding Greenstand brand, and it shows no Greenstand logo until Greenstand approves one (PRODUCT.md).
Don't load a font or another asset from a third-party host; vendor it and pin its hash.
Don't take a value from `BASE_STYLE`; it is the former look.
Don't put the parcel field under the content column. It belongs to the legend rail and the masthead only.
Don't add fills or a hatch to the parcel field. A hatch is the mark of a best guess.
Don't show a real place or a capture in the parcel field, and do not call the field a map, a wallpaper, or a background illustration. It is decoration, not data.
